cooling_estimate.caveat: Observational association only; it does not prove causation or guarantee that an intervention will cause this cooling.
cooling_estimate.statistic: Pearson correlation and ordinary-least-squares association between cell NDVI and LST in Celsius

scoring.normalization: min-max reference range across complete, non-water, non-bare priority-eligible cells; normalized values for bare-land cells are clamped to 0-1 and never affect eligible-cell scores; constant NDVI/LST uses 0.5; constant population uses 0 when all reference values are zero, otherwise 0.5; if no priority-eligible cells exist, normalized values and scores are unavailable
scoring.normalization_population: Complete non-water cells with bare probability <= 0.5; bare-land cells are scored against these ranges for display only.
scoring.score_formula: exposure = 0.5 * normalized(LST) + 0.5 * (1 - normalized(NDVI)); priority = exposure * (0.5 + 0.5 * normalized(population))
scoring.top_list_rule: ceil(10% of complete, non-water, non-bare cells); sorted by score descending, then stable cell ID ascending.
scoring.water_rule: NDVI < 0 is excluded from scoring and top-list ranking.
